about.title: Cooperstown Dreams Park 12U Tournament
paragraphs: The Cooperstown Dreams Park 12U tournament is a week-long, highly competitive youth baseball experience in Cooperstown, New York. The August 7–13, 2027 week will bring together teams from across the country for a combination of pool play, bracket competition, and the full Cooperstown experience.

The tournament begins with check-in, team activities and the Opening Ceremony/Skills Competitions, followed by several days of pool-play games. Teams then advance into single-elimination bracket play, where every game becomes win-or-go-home. Cooperstown guarantees teams at least six games, with the possibility of playing as many as 13 games, weather permitting.

The week is much more than baseball. Players stay together in the Cooperstown Dreams Park team clubhouses, eat meals together, participate in team activities and experience the unique atmosphere of playing against teams from around the country. The week also includes the American Youth Baseball Hall of Fame experience, tournament traditions, pin trading, and the opportunity to create memories with teammates and families.
